blocking_limitations.finding: scripts/launch_fliptrack_eval_shards.sh accepts a checkpoint provenance binding only for job_type l13_mechanical_pilot_arm / m3_mechanical_pilot_arm (BLIND_GAINS_PILOT_*) or m5_anchor_longhorizon_400 (BLIND_GAINS_M5_*). The Mini-A5 training runs carry job_type m6_mini_a5_registered_main, which no branch accepts.
blocking_limitations.verified_by: grep -n mini_a5 scripts/launch_fliptrack_eval_shards.sh -> no match; jq .job_type on both Mini-A5 training manifests -> m6_mini_a5_registered_main
blocking_limitations.consequence: The 6 F8 runs must be launched on the UNBOUND path (no BLIND_GAINS_PILOT_*/BLIND_GAINS_M5_* env vars). Their run_manifest.json will therefore record source_training_run=null, source_training_job_type=null, global_step=null, checkpoint_index_sha256=null, evaluation_scope=null.
blocking_limitations.mitigation_chosen: Provenance is carried out-of-band by this plan file and by a post-run reports/mini_a5_f8_run_provenance_v1.json that records, per run dir: arm, source training run, global_step 120, checkpoint path, checkpoint index sha256, manifest sha256. No contract file is modified.
blocking_limitations.mitigation_not_chosen: Adding an m6_mini_a5_registered_main branch to scripts/launch_fliptrack_eval_shards.sh. That file is a named M5 contract file (git-diff-gated by scripts/launch_m5_fliptrack_checkpoint_eval.sh); amending it is a registration decision, not a preparation step. NOT DONE.
blocking_limitations.side_effect_that_is_actually_safe: The launcher's 'locked R19 manifest' guard (line 171) fires only when a binding is present. On the unbound path the R20 and chart-v08 manifests are accepted, which is what the addendum requires.

blocking_limitations.finding: The addendum pins bootstrap seed 20260729. scripts/compare_fliptrack_runs.py uses the passed seed for the pooled summary (lenient) and seed+1 (strict), and for the k-th template in sorted order uses seed+100+10k (lenient) / seed+100+10k+1 (strict).
blocking_limitations.assessment: Deterministic derivation from the pinned seed, fixed before any value is read. Recorded here rather than discovered later.

blocking_limitations.finding: scripts/aggregate_fliptrack_eval.py reports pair_accuracy_ci95_low/high from a SINGLE-ARM bootstrap with seed hard-coded to 0 inside src.eval.fliptrack_metrics.pair_accuracy_ci, and only on the lenient contract.
blocking_limitations.consequence: Those fields are descriptive per-arm intervals. The registered interval is the PAIRED CP-minus-member interval from scripts/compare_fliptrack_runs.py. Do not report the aggregate CI as the endpoint interval.

blocking_limitations.finding: The repo is shared with the live M7 workstream on the same branch. During this preparation the M7 staged edits (configs/train/m7_virl_*.yaml, reports/m7_arm_configs_v1.json, scripts/build_m7_configs.py) were committed as 23c53ff, moving HEAD. A modified reports/storage_usage_snapshot.json and many untracked tmp/ files remain. The unbound launcher path performs no cleanliness gate; it records git_hash from HEAD only.
blocking_limitations.consequence: The git_hash recorded in each F8 run_manifest.json will be whatever HEAD is at launch, which may again differ from 23c53ff, and will not describe the untracked/modified remainder. No dirty or concurrently-committed file is in the FlipTrack evaluation path - verified by an explicit git diff --name-only over the launcher, worker, comparison/aggregation scripts, src/eval, src/analysis/blind_solvability.py and the two data manifests.
blocking_limitations.recommended_action_for_execution_step: Re-run 'git status --porcelain' immediately before launch and record it verbatim in reports/mini_a5_f8_run_provenance_v1.json.

blocking_limitations.finding: The addendum pins data/fliptrack_r20_source_manifest.jsonl. Every prior base-model R20 FlipTrack eval used experiments/runs/caption_qa_pair_build_fliptrack_r20_private_full_v1_20260711T124039Z/shards/captions_shard_0.jsonl (sha256 525e1104...). Verified: the two describe the SAME 1200 items (identical image_a/image_b sha256 pair set; pinned pair_id set == prior source_pair_id set; same 3 template ids) but use DIFFERENT pair_id keys.
blocking_limitations.consequence: CP-vs-member F8 R20 comparison is unaffected (both arms use the pinned manifest, so pair_ids join). Any later join of F8 R20 numbers to the Paper-1 base-model R20 numbers must go through source_pair_id, not pair_id; scripts/compare_fliptrack_runs.py joins on pair_id and would raise a coverage mismatch.

RUN_TS="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"   # set ONCE; shared by all six run dirs
execution.serialization_note: scripts/launch_fliptrack_eval_shards.sh takes flock -n on /tmp/blind_gains_an29_fliptrack_eval_launch.lock. Two launcher invocations must not overlap; launch the two cells of a stage one after the other (each returns in seconds), not in parallel.
execution.stage_gate: Before starting the next stage, wait until BOTH run_manifest.json files of the current stage report .status == "complete". The launcher refuses any GPU with a live compute app (exit 75), so an early next-stage launch fails closed rather than colliding.

readout_step_commands.warning: These OPEN accuracy. They belong to the readout step, NOT to this preparation step. None of them has been run.

per_cell_aggregate.note: Yields lenient pair_accuracy and contract-strict strict_pair_accuracy plus per_template breakdowns (I7). Its pair_accuracy_ci95_* fields are single-arm and are NOT the registered interval.

readout_step_commands.sign_convention: --left = member (same-data standard GRPO), --right = CP. The script reports right minus left, i.e. CP minus member, which is the registered direction.

instrument_conformance_to_addendum_secti.paired_item_bootstrap: yes - src.analysis.blind_solvability.bootstrap_mean_ci resamples the per-pair difference vector, which is identical to resampling both arms on the same pair indices per replicate
instrument_conformance_to_addendum_secti.seed_20260729: passed via --seed; see blocking_limitations.per_template_bootstrap_seed_is_derived for the derived per-template seeds
instrument_conformance_to_addendum_secti.unit_pair_id: yes - scripts/compare_fliptrack_runs.py indexes both arms by pair_id, rejects duplicates, and raises on any coverage or template mismatch
instrument_conformance_to_addendum_secti.exact_mcnemar_two_sided: yes - _paired_exact, reported for both contracts (mcnemar and strict_mcnemar)
instrument_conformance_to_addendum_secti.both_contracts_I7: yes - pair_accuracy_delta (lenient) and strict_pair_accuracy_delta (contract-strict), each with its own CI and McNemar

primary.role: primary visual anchor - coordinate survey register

secondaries_same_file_separate_rows.role: saturated positive control / retention canary; a drop signals damage

endpoint_extraction.I13_guard: scripts/compare_fliptrack_runs.py also emits POOLED top-level R19 numbers over all 1200 pairs. Those pool three distinct scientific roles and MUST NOT be reported as an endpoint. Report them, if at all, only as a labelled non-endpoint diagnostic.
endpoint_extraction.decision_rule_verbatim_from_addendum: 'Moves' means the CP-minus-member difference on the primary anchor has a 95% paired-bootstrap CI excluding zero in the positive direction. A positive point estimate whose interval contains zero is reported as not moved, not as a trend.
endpoint_extraction.sets_reported_separately: R19, R20 and chart-v08 are three different instruments and are never averaged together (I13).

invariants_respected.I7: Both lenient and contract-strict scoring are produced and reported for every metric in every cell.
invariants_respected.I11: R19 and R20 are read-only. Nothing in this plan modifies, regenerates or trains on them; the only writes are new run directories under experiments/runs/ and new files under reports/.
invariants_respected.I13: Per-template (per-role) reporting is mandatory; pooled R19 numbers are marked non-endpoint. The three evaluation sets are never aggregated together.
invariants_respected.resource_isolation: All six cells run on an29 only. an12 GPUs 0-3 (M7 arm 1) are never touched; an12 GPUs 4-7 are left unused.
invariants_respected.single_node_placement: Each cell is 4 TP1 replicas on one node. No cell spans an12 and an29.
